# Error Constant

![Error Constant function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/error/23-constant.svg)

[Error functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Creates an editable status/code/source cluster with the initial no-error value false, zero and empty string. This value is not an exception.
